name: verso
description: Verso – Synced lyrics and focus mode for YouTube Music (Chrome, Edge + Firefox extension)
author: Gabriel Sena

scripts.dev:firefox: pnpm run build firefox --dev && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --target firefox-desktop
scripts.lint:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: pnpm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename verso-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/edge --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename verso-edge-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename verso-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
